create_quark_int4fp8_config: create a QuarkInt4Fp8Config instance for online INT4-to-FP8 MoE quantization on AMD GPUs
build_moe_quant_method: build a QuarkInt4Fp8MoEMethod that loads BF16/FP16 checkpoints, quantizes to INT4, and dequantizes to FP8 at inference
test_quantize_weights: test online INT4-FP8 weight quantization with per-tensor FP8 scale and per-column INT4 scale for MoE experts
run_fused_moe_inference: run fused MoE inference using INT4 weights with FP8 scales via aiter fused_moe kernel on HIP GPUs
process_weights_after_loading: process and shuffle MoE weights after loading, merging w1/w3 FP8 scales and rescaling INT4 scales for single per-expert scale
